title: Roth IRA vs 401(k): Which Should You Prioritize?
summary: A common order is 401(k) up to the match, then a Roth IRA, then back to the 401(k). 2026 limits, income caps and SECURE 2.0 changes, sourced.
body_markdown:
## How Astor fits in


Astor is a personal investing agent on iPhone and in iMessage, and the company behind it, Gaus, Inc. DBA Astor, is an SEC-registered investment adviser. It connects through Plaid to brokerage, retirement and crypto accounts at most major US institutions, so it can see what you hold in your 401(k), your Roth IRA and any other accounts you connect. You can ask about your actual holdings, like how your mix compares across the two accounts, and with[scheduled alerts](https://www.astor.app/blog/scheduled-alerts) you can ask it to check something on a schedule, such as a look at your retirement accounts every December.


Astor doesn’t hold your money, doesn’t move it between accounts, and doesn’t do tax filing. How much you contribute, and to which account, is your decision. The AI can be wrong, which is why it shows its sources. Astor is free to start, and you can[see how it works](https://www.astor.app/#how-it-works) . If you hold several funds across accounts, our guide on[how often to rebalance your 401(k)](https://www.astor.app/blog/rebalance-your-401k) covers keeping the mix on target.
